name: Lima Beans
siboNotes: Lima beans are high in galactans (GOS) which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Start with very small portions (1/4 cup or less) and monitor tolerance carefully.
preparationTips: Rinse canned lima beans thoroughly to reduce FODMAP content
Start with baby lima beans as they may be better tolerated
Soak dried lima beans overnight and discard soaking water before cooking
Combine with digestive spices like cumin or fennel seeds
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of folate and potassium
